title: Research: close the PR390 heterogeneous physical provider in exact RAM
body:
Closes the source-specific heterogeneous physical-provider and ordinary exact-RAM argument for the pinned PR390 word. PR390 already supplies the prefix rewrites, dirty preconditioning, early sinks, phased adapters, inverse owners and m73/W58899 profile; this addendum adds the universal frame/dirty/owner argument and a fully charged closed ordinary-RAM witness. It makes no circuit or selected-bound change.

For every fixed K and positive tensor multiplicity, the explicit heterogeneous word acts correctly on all actual live arrays, including correlated helper dirt. Its optimized B4 instance gives exact Gaussian/Walsh work `O(N(log(N+2))^(1023/1024))` on powers of two. The old homogeneous sink contract remains false; the separate paid repair is distinguished.

The all-length cyclic consequence uses the literal Sussman transfer at `f010392c923279e3dd59ef3aa5fedad23affc5fd`: supplied canonical positive root at selected `0<D(N)<8N^3`, one root primitive and all preparation/index/allocation costs charged, with inherited exponent `1-7474546/10^10`. The transfer mechanisms, root convention and cyclic exponent are credited rather than presented as new.

The model is unit-cost exact scalar/index RAM with a fixed polynomial word/arena cap and unrestricted scalar heights. This is proof-level mathematical admission, not a new Lean kernel certificate, original Family130 manuscript equivalence, root-free field algorithm, bit/precision/tape/caller-ABI closure, practical crossover or global integer multiplication result.

Completed independent AI referee results were reused rather than rerun. They cover the complete scalar columns, phased charts, owner/phase/invoice profile and downstream algebra/model chain. The supplied standard-library scalar replay has unchanged mathematical functions with relocated pinned public inputs; it checks the finite scalar leaf only. No contributor program, installation, full repository suite, new Lean build or new Pro run was performed during preparation.

Adds 12 files in one new research directory, including three exact public literal inputs, a source-bound proof note, exact profile, attribution and the own scalar replay. No source mirror, selected record, generator, workflow or upstream file changes. Substantial OpenAI Codex and ChatGPT Pro assistance is disclosed; independent AI checks are not described as independent human peer review. Raw private Pro/referee output is excluded.

Credits PR390 and its retained predecessor notices; Jacob Sussman's frame/bank/RAM/Fourier work and existing P193 supplier; the PR363/373/375/377/381/397 bridge lineage; PR401 normalization; PR430's conditional interface audit; and OpenAI/math's exact-width, sector, CRT/chirp and uniform-transfer lineage. The bounded comparison is a source-specific contribution assessment, not worldwide novelty or an upstream endorsement.

Two completed independent mathematical admissions and a local release-text/source-binding check support this version. No release-specific Opus review or new mathematical replay was performed; no CI pass is claimed at submission. A package-local byte-preservation rule retains the exact copied public source bytes under the repository line-ending policy.
